section_1.title: Prerequisite Review: From Arrows to Objects
section_1.content: Briefly revisit Euclidean vectors as arrows in 2D/3D space (magnitude and direction). Introduce the shift: what if a 'vector' isn't just an arrow, but a polynomial, a function, or a matrix?
section_1.example: Visualize a 2D arrow vs. a sine wave f(x) = sin(x) being treated as a single 'point' in a function space.

section_2.title: Defining the Arena: The 8 Axioms
section_2.content: Introduce the abstract vector space as a set of objects (vectors) equipped with two operations: addition and scalar multiplication. Explain that as long as they follow the 'Rules of the Game' (Axioms like commutativity, associativity, and identity), the objects qualify as vectors.
section_2.example: Analogy of a 'Universal Library': Whether the books are comic books or novels, if they follow the library's organization rules (axioms), they are all valid 'Library Contents'.

section_3.title: Visualizing Abstract Spaces
section_3.content: Demonstrate the abstract concept using a 'State Space' visualization. Use a character (a robot) to show that all possible configurations (position, velocity, angle) form a vector space, even if the visual doesn't look like an arrow.
section_3.example: A robot moving in a grid: Its configuration vector V = [x, y, θ]. Changing the configuration follows vector addition, even if the robot isn't drawing a physical arrow.

section_4.title: Concrete Application: Sound Synthesis
section_4.content: Show how abstract vector spaces are applied in audio engineering. Explain that any complex sound wave is a linear combination (a vector sum) of basic sine wave vectors.
section_4.example: Two birds singing: The total song is the vector sum of Bird A's frequency vector and Bird B's frequency vector within the 'Sound Vector Space'.

section_5.title: Summary and Conclusion
section_5.content: Reinforce that abstract vector spaces provide a universal language. They allow us to use linear algebra tools on non-spatial data, enabling everything from AI image processing to quantum mechanics.
section_5.example: A final visual showing an arrow, a matrix, and a function wave converging into a single 'Vector Space' umbrella symbol.
